title: Keep retired custody valid across audited custodian drift so the recorded reopen remedy stays reachable
description: Keep retired custody valid across audited custodian drift so the recorded reopen remedy stays reachable
acceptance_criteria: Reopening a drifted retirement custodian no longer aborts on the retired records' custody validation; after audited re-acceptance with evolved digests, custody still validates while owners hold; owner or path loss still refuses
